text: I. Core Curriculum Framework: Three-dimensional Cultivation from Language to CultureThe major of Foreign Languages and Literatures takes "language skills + literary studies + cultural cognition" as its three pillars. The curriculum design is both professional and interdisciplinary. The following is an explanation from four major modules:Ii. Language Skills Courses: Advancement from basic to specialized AbilitiesPronunciation and OrthographyThe pronunciation rules of the target language (such as the uvular sounds in Spanish and the soft consonants in Russian);Learning of the writing system (rules for the mixed use of Japanese kana and kanji, writing norms for Arabic).Grammar and Vocabulary SystemMorphology (noun declension, verb conjugation, such as the six types of conjugation in Latin);Syntactic structures (such as German box structures and French subjunctive clauses);Professional vocabulary accumulation (by field: legal, medical, and technological terms).Basic skills trainingSituational dialogue (daily communication, business reception)Intensive reading and writing (analyzing short story fragments, writing letters/reports).
